generate_anchor_boxes: generate a matrix of anchor boxes in x1 y1 x2 y2 format with custom stride sizes and aspect ratios
generate_anchors_with_ratios: generate anchor reference windows by enumerating aspect ratios and scales for a base window
compute_anchor_center: compute the width height x center and y center for a given anchor window
build_anchors_from_dimensions: build a set of anchor windows from width height vectors and a center point
enumerate_anchor_scales: enumerate anchor boxes for each scale factor relative to a base anchor window
